title: The Ra II: Ra II proves its point
version: Cornell Alumni News, December 1970, p.13; first-person Ra II navigator account
lineage: Contemporaneous participant primary source, retained as original PDF. Direct evidence of project-level iteration; not evidence of reedboat invention.

passages.locator: Printed p.13, PDF page 14, Ra I flexing and Ra II construction paragraphs
passages.note: Baker attributes Ra I failure to structural flexing that wore lashings; says shorter, more rigid Aymara-built Ra II resisted flexing.
